zoe (android): quick heads up - onboarding sample with chunked image uploads + auth refresh shows long tail latency and occasional OOM after backgrounding the app. reproducible on Pixel 6a Android 13.

mike (sdk): OOM after backgrounding? sounds like some resource not released on cancel. does the leak happen if you pause then resume, or only when you kill from recents?

zoe (android): we background (home) during large upload while a 401 triggers refresh. UI goes background, upload keeps going, refresh happens, then on resume app sometimes crashes with OOM. heap shows many buffered byte[] and leaked Streams.

pranav (eng-runtime): two vectors: 1) Auth refresh using same OkHttpClient can block waiting for a connection while uploads hold sockets; if app backgrounding delays GC and threads hold references the leak can look like OOM. 2) RequestBody streaming not closing source on lifecycle events.

mike (sdk): can you paste how cancel/background is handled?

zoe (android): we call call.cancel() in onStop and set a flag to hide spinner. RequestBody is streaming via Okio.source(file) and progress posts via Handler.postAtFrontOfQueue for snappy updates. Authenticator does blocking `.execute()` refresh on same client.

mike (sdk): a few red flags: `postAtFrontOfQueue` can starve main looper ordering and keep messages pinned; blocking `.execute()` in Authenticator on the same client can exhaust dispatcher sockets; and closing streams only via call.cancel() may not close file source.

pranav (eng-runtime): pragmatic fixes: 1) make Authenticator return null so 401 surfaces to app; coalesce refreshes in a coroutine/singleFlight outside OkHttp. 2) create a tiny auth-only OkHttpClient (2 connections) used only for refresh calls if you keep Authenticator approach. 3) make RequestBody close source in finally and check for cancellation flag between reads; also call `source.close()` from lifecycle onStop to unblock writes. 4) drop postAtFrontOfQueue -> use post() and batch progress events.

zoe (android): example patch for RequestBody: `try (Source src = Okio.source(file)) { while ((r = src.read(buf,8192)) != -1) { if (cancelled.get()) { src.close(); throw new IOException("cancelled"); } sink.write(buf, r); } } finally { /* ensure closed */ }`

mike (sdk): also add `call.timeout().cancel()` in cancellation path to interrupt blocking socket ops on some Android runtimes. we've added that to coroutine adapter samples.

zoe (android): thanks. i'll try auth-client quickfix + explicit source.close() on onStop and switch to post(). will report back after CI.

ci-bot: build queued (branch: fix/auth-pool-224500).

pranav (eng-runtime): if you can attach a small repro apk/steps we can add an emulator smoke test for background cancel + auth refresh to catch regressions.

zoe (android): will upload repro tomorrow. thanks all :thumbsup:
